name: Tune Advisor Apply
rationale:
The Tune Advisor's Save writes its suggested changes to the FC. Pins
what reaches the FC: only the advised fields change, and nothing is
written unless every read is complete (a short reply would decode as a
tune of zeros), the FC still holds the tune the flights were flown on
(same values and profiles) and the model is disarmed; a failed write is
never committed to EEPROM; F is never applied without its rates (a
percentage-only rates_type applies neither); advice that would leave a
setting's range is not offered; a full-stick rate cut is one 20% step;
P is raised at most 50% above the pilot's own P (from changes.csv);
each stage is shown; a shaking axis that gets no P step still names the shake in its reasons (issue #2643); advice refreshes when the PID profile changes on the same aircraft. Issues #2639, #2640 and #2642: with polar cyclic on, roll gets no rate or F advice; a cyclic ring below 100% caps the rate asked at full stick; an axis that I-term relax does not act on gets no cut-off advice; and Apply refuses a flight whose Cyclic polarity, ring or I-term relax type differs from the FC. Issue #2808: the FC writes into whichever profile is active when each write arrives, so Apply asks MSP_STATUS for the active PID and rate profile before the reads, before each write, before the EEPROM commit and after the read-back; a switch before the first write changes nothing, a switch between writes stops before the next write and the commit, and a switch during the read-back is reported as unconfirmed. Each write leaves the MSP queue once (maxRetries = 0) and is resent by the page after a fresh profile check, so a lost reply's resend cannot land on a profile selected since the check; the resends are bounded at 6 attempts. The outcome dialog opens after the page is refocused, not before: a focus call made while it is open moved focus behind it, and on a radio without a touch screen (X14) its OK could not be reached.
